name: Turkey Bolognese with Courgette & Penne
method: Brown the turkey mince with the chopped onion, grated carrot and sliced mushrooms in the oil. Stir in the tomato puree, garlic and mixed herbs.
Add the chopped tomatoes, passata and diced courgette and simmer for 25 minutes until thick and the turkey is cooked through.
Cook the penne and serve the sauce over it.
